title_zh: 核对课堂案例中的转载许可

scenario.label_zh: 核对诗歌转载案例中的许可
scenario.goal_zh: 依据课堂案例给出的许可条件判断所述转载并修正一概而论的说法

context_zh: 学生在课堂上讨论教师编写的虚构版权案例，不涉及真实转载或法律建议。
author: author-phase05-c

sentences.speaker: Imogen
sentences.text: My answer says it is illegal for the school magazine to print the poem.

sentences.speaker: Felix
sentences.text: Did you read the last paragraph of the case? The author gave written permission for this issue.

sentences.speaker: Imogen
sentences.text: I missed that. I assumed every reprint needed a payment.

sentences.speaker: Felix
sentences.text: In this example, the permission is free, as long as the magazine prints her name and does not change the poem.

sentences.speaker: Imogen
sentences.text: So the reprint described here is legal because it meets those conditions. I should not give the same answer for every possible case.

sentences.speaker: Felix
sentences.text: Exactly. Add the conditions to your explanation instead of just changing yes to no.

sentences.speaker: Imogen
sentences.text: I will. Then I will ask the teacher to check that I have explained the distinction clearly.
